sql:
SELECT a.element 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = 'TR004'
